provenance_rules.all_assets: original procedural geometry authored by the B asset domain in this repository; no downloaded models, textures, scans or third-party installers; license see simulator/assets/LICENSES.md
provenance_rules.bounds: declared envelope is the closed-form design bound; measured AABB values below come from the independent double-precision Python replica of the exact generator formulas (replica script recorded in evidence); the runtime factory re-measures actual transformed mesh vertices and stores geometry_bounds_m and pivot_bound_radius_m as metadata on every instance; measured_engine_20261016 blocks hold real engine values from the 2026-10-16 MEASURE lines and supersede replica values where they differ
provenance_rules.volumes: mesh volume computed by the divergence theorem over the same triangles; star-mesh volumes are replica values for the exact deterministic vertex formulas; fault and casing are closed-form prism volumes; volume_m3 now quotes the real-engine value measured 2026-10-16 under the explicit Godot clockwise front-face convention (-sum(p0.dot(p1.cross(p2)))/6 over the stored triangle order, positive for an outward closed solid)
provenance_rules.front_face_winding: Godot ArrayMesh front faces are clockwise: the custom star meshes in world/obstacle_geometry.gd are index-wound clockwise with outward vertex normals (correction-02 fixed the previous counter-clockwise order); BoxMesh and CylinderMesh primitives already encode clockwise front faces; the contract test asserts per-face outward orientation, no mixed winding and an opposite-winding negative control
